event_counts_caveat: AVOID_TURN/AVOID_PASS/RECOVER counts above are raw regex line-match counts over the whole controller.log, NOT true mode-entry counts -- they also match periodic per-tick diagnostic lines (e.g. 'ARMED mode=AVOID_TURN ...') logged while a robot REMAINS in a mode, not just the TRANSITION line that enters it. The independent TRANSITION-specific, robot-tagged regex in analyze_objective5_trajectory.py confirms the TRUE structure is exactly ONE CRUISE->AVOID_TURN, ONE AVOID_TURN->AVOID_PASS, and ONE ->RECOVER transition per robot. local_layer_engaged=false is unaffected by this caveat (LOCAL_* keys had zero matches under either counting method).
